*The Spiritist Essays* is a personal collection of essays by Ovande Furtado Jr. on Spiritism, as codified by Allan Kardec, and its dialogue with contemporary scientific research — consciousness, identity, health, moral development, and human evolution. The essays are fully cited but not peer reviewed. [More about this site](about.qmd).
